purpose.summary: Batch report program that produces a Creditor's Purchases Journal for an accounts payable / creditor management system. It reads creditor, transaction, control, and parameter files and prints a formatted journal report with date ranges, branch details, supplier lines, GRN/invoice numbers, costs, and selling prices.

CRT STATUS / CONSOLE IS CRT — interactive screen handling extensions
COMP-5 (Micro Focus native binary) for indexes and counters
Multiple COPY statements for file-control, FDE, and working-storage segments
Printer detail record with multiple REDEFINES for different line layouts
GPL open-source licence notice embedded in SECURITY paragraph
